meta.title: Create Audit Infrastructure & Findings Schema
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create the foundational infrastructure for the code audit process, including directory structure, YAML schema for capturing findings, and helper scripts for consistency.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Audit directory structure created: tests/live/audit/ with findings/, reports/, checklists/ subdirectories
Finding YAML schema supports: id, severity, module, description, recommendation, status, regression_test fields
Pydantic validation for finding entries exists with severity enum (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
Three empty finding YAML files created: core_findings.yaml, brokers_findings.yaml, streaming_findings.yaml
Helper script exists to add/update findings maintaining schema compliance

key-tasks.task: Define Finding YAML schema with Pydantic models
Create empty findings YAML files with headers
Create helper script for findings management

architecture-context.pattern: Severity levels: CRITICAL (must fix before production), HIGH (must fix before deployment), MEDIUM (should fix, can defer), LOW (nice to have)
architecture-context.constraint: All findings must have unique IDs following pattern AUDIT-{MODULE}-{NUMBER}
Status values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, VERIFIED

technical-specifications.spec: @dataclass class Finding: id: str # AUDIT-E001, AUDIT-B001, etc. severity: Literal["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"] module: str # rustybt.live.engine, rustybt.live.brokers, etc. description: str recommendation: str status: Literal["OPEN", "IN_PROGRESS", "RESOLVED", "VERIFIED"] regression_test: str | None = None found_at: str | None = None resolved_at: str | None = None

dependencies.dependency: This is the first story in Epic 10, no dependencies

nfr-references.nfr: All order state transitions logged for audit
